items.title: 5 reported dead, 42 rescued after ferry fire off Palawan
items.description: At least five people were reported dead while 42 others have been rescued after a fire broke out off Coron, Palawan on Wednesday, September 9, the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) said.

items.title: Philippines only country where rich-poor gap in reading gains widened in PISA 2025
items.description: Filipino students of every background achieved better reading scores in the 2025 PISA than in 2022. But scores climbed almost three times higher among the richest demographic of students than the poorest.

items.title: [Vantage Point] Villar Land: Follow the P1.3-trillion paper trail
items.description: The documents I have in possession establish the acquisition, revaluation, and recognition of enormous accounting gains. They also establish that Villar Land subsequently carried an extraordinary stock-market valuation.

items.title: Trump advisers warn Iran conflict may last through end of his term, WSJ reports
items.description: The report comes as Iran and the US launch the biggest wave of attacks on shipping so far since the start of the six-month-old war

items.title: 'Negative na': Small Manila businesses cut staff, take loans over steep garbage fees
items.description: One to two trash bags a day, P60,000 garbage bill: Manila businesses are crying foul over new garbage fees.

items.title: Barangay execs’ term extension slammed
items.description: he extension of the terms of barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan  officials is a violation of the 1987 Constitution, Kabataan party-list said yesterday.

items.title: Mans Carpio’s bank records disclosure complaint junked
items.description: The Office of the City Prosecutor in Quezon City has recommended the dismissal of the complaint filed by Manases Carpio, the husband of Vice President Sara Duterte, over the alleged violation of bank secrecy laws by several House members and government officials.

items.title: NBI discovers ‘double payments’ for SEAG cauldron
items.description: The National Bureau of Investigation claimed that the P55-million cauldron used in the 2019 Southeast Asian (SEA) Games was possibly overpriced after discovering a “double payment” while constructing the structure.

items.title: Up to 3 cyclones expected
items.description: Up to three tropical cyclones are expected to enter or develop inside the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR) this month, according to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration.

items.title: Some senators want SC to decide on impeach vote threshold
items.description: Senators JV Ejercito and Raffy Tulfo want the Supreme Court to decide on the voting threshold to convict or acquit Vice President Sara Duterte amid a possible deadlock due to the continued absence of four senators.

items.title: Ombudsman to oppose Martin’s bid for hospital detention
items.description: The Office of the Ombudsman will “strongly oppose” the bid of Leyte congressman and former speaker Martin Romualdez for continued hospital confinement as he faces detention for a non-bailable P7.4-billion plunder charge.

items.title: Marcos Jr. attending BRICS summit in India
items.description: President Marcos will visit New Delhi, India from Sept. 12 to 13 to participate in the 18th BRICS Summit.

items.description: GCash's blockbuster IPO could turn years of paper gains into billions for its early private equity backers. For the retail investors buying in now, the question is how much growth still remains.
